purpose: Close mechanical execution ambiguities without changing the THY-003 hypothesis, information set, candidate, controls, repositories, horizons, seeds, or gates.

source_frame.task_material_time: created_at interpreted as UTC when timezone-naive
source_frame.binding: Load Task identities through the frozen THY-002 source loader, construct its unchanged rolling schedule, and bind each Origin cutoff and commit to the accepted THY-002 raw result. Do not infer a new schedule.

scoring_label.definition: A Task is positive exactly when a diff --git header names package.json, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, or yarn.lock at repository root on either side.
scoring_label.loading_barrier: Build and digest all candidate and lock-only memberships before loading any reference patch or scoring label into the evaluation phase.
scoring_label.binary_brier: For forecast probability p and binary label y, Task loss is (p-y)^2. Average Tasks within Origin, Origins within repository, then repositories equally.

state_cells_and_admission.coverage_denominator: One cell for every distinct declared direct package within each required Task or Origin state point: (repository_id, state_kind, state_id, package_name). A package declared in both scopes contributes one production cell.
state_cells_and_admission.coverage_numerator: A denominator cell whose first-present lockfile records an exact stable direct version and whose retained packument has a parseable time[that_version] timestamp at or before that state cutoff.
state_cells_and_admission.missing_snapshot_cells: A historical Task with no supported state contributes no dependency cells and is separately reported as a missing-state Task. Every Origin must have a supported nonempty state.
state_cells_and_admission.variation_identity: Distinct Origin state vectors are compared as exact normalized rational values.

snapshot_and_lock_rules.snapshot: Use the latest first-parent commit returned by git rev-list --first-parent --max-count=1 --before=<UTC cutoff> HEAD. Each frozen Origin must equal the commit bound by the parent result.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.precedence: Use the first present lockfile in the parent plan's order. A malformed or unsupported first-present file does not fall through to a lower-precedence file.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.empty_direct_dependencies: A zero-direct-dependency historical snapshot is a missing-state marker; the same condition at an Origin is inadmissible.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.npm_lock: For lockfileVersion 1 read dependencies[name].version. For versions 2 and 3 read packages[node_modules/name].version, including scoped names.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.pnpm_lock: Read only importer '.' dependencies and devDependencies. A scalar value or mapping.version may remove one pnpm peer-context suffix beginning with '_' in lockfile 5 or '(' in later lockfiles; the remaining whole prefix must be strict stable x.y.z.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.yarn_classic: Match the direct manifest selector name@declared_spec to a Yarn v1 stanza and read its version. Combined selector stanzas are allowed.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.yarn_berry: Parse the mapping and match name@declared_spec or name@npm:declared_spec in a selector key; read that entry's version.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.unknown: Workspace, file, Git, URL, npm alias, unmatched selector, range-only, prerelease, build metadata, malformed, and non-strict versions are unknown.
snapshot_and_lock_rules.no_manifest_range_use: Manifest ranges identify direct declarations and Yarn selectors only; they never supply a resolved version.

numeric_and_selection_rules.distance: Represent category counts, denominators, L1 distance, weights, and forecast rates as exact rational numbers through membership creation. Convert only final forecast probabilities to IEEE-754 binary64 for Brier reporting.
numeric_and_selection_rules.tie: Apply the frozen SHA-256 tie-break only when exact rational distances are equal.
numeric_and_selection_rules.lock_only: For every declared package, map a strict stable version resolved from the first-present lockfile to current without reading registry data; retain every other package as unknown. Repeat both continuous and materialized pipelines.
numeric_and_selection_rules.lock_only_gate: The formal decision compares registry-dated materialized loss with lock-only materialized loss. Continuous lock-only loss is reported as an ablation diagnostic.

uncertainty_and_null.bootstrap: Generate one 20000-draw matrix in frozen repository order; each draw samples nine repository indices with replacement. Reuse the matrix for every paired wide-frame contrast. Sort draw means and report zero-based order statistics 500 and 19500 as the 95 percent interval.
uncertainty_and_null.leave_one_repository_out: For each repository in frozen order, report the arithmetic mean contrast over the other eight repositories.
uncertainty_and_null.temporal_null: For each of 20000 draws and each repository in frozen order, draw one offset uniformly from integers 1 through origin_count-1. For chronological Origin index i use the donor Origin state at (i+offset) modulo origin_count, recompute the materialized selection against the same historical Tasks, and score H5. The donor Origin identity never enters the candidate tie-break.
uncertainty_and_null.temporal_null_rate: Count null H5 materialized-minus-full macro contrasts less than or equal to the true contrast and divide by 20000, with no plus-one correction.

freeze_order: Commit this addendum before implementing accepted Stage A.
Test and commit the runner and parser fixtures before registry acquisition.
Acquire each distinct package packument once and retain its raw response, URL, status, query time, byte count, and SHA-256.
Create a separate execution lock binding the committed runner, dependency versions, repository heads, and raw registry manifest before reading any candidate result.
Run twice offline from the same frozen responses and require byte-identical accepted outputs.

terminal_states.invalid_execution: An implementation, identity, verifier, or reproduction defect; not scientific evidence.
terminal_states.external_blocker: Registry or source acquisition could not be completed; not scientific evidence.
terminal_states.retired_source_admission: A verified accepted run fails a frozen source-admission gate.
terminal_states.retired_stage_a: Source admission passes but one or more frozen Stage-A scientific gates fail.
terminal_states.passed_stage_a: Every source and Stage-A gate passes; only a separate outcome plan may be designed.
